_comment: Pre-existing failures tolerated by scripts/sc7f0_release_tests.py. Each entry states why it is not a release blocker and what would clear it. Anything failing that is not listed here fails the release gate; anything listed here that starts passing also fails the gate, so the baseline cannot rot silently.

Unrelated to the FPGA bitstream, the PS image or the upgrade package. Cleared by rebuilding the MCU candidate from the matching source.
